summary: Re-verification of iteration-1 fixes for Nice2Meechu. Backend pytest: 24/24 pass (one outdated assertion auto-corrected: SAMPLE_VIDEOS now use /videos/v*.mp4 instead of https URLs - test updated). Frontend: full happy path re-tested at 480x900. (1) Chat send button is NOW REACHABLE - native (non-force) click SUCCESS, topmost element under the center is the SVG icon inside the button (not the Emergent badge). Message round-trip works: 'retest hello' was sent and demo replied 'tell me more about that'. (2) Bottom-nav YOU button (data-testid=nav-profile) NOW REACHABLE - non-force click SUCCESS, profile screen renders @tester. (3) Feed videos load - <video> currentSrc=https://.../videos/v*.webm, readyState=4, videoWidth=480, videoHeight=270 (Chromium WebM fallback works). (4) Translation overlay appears within ~2s with 'TRANSLATED · EN→ES' label and Spanish text e.g. 'Voy en bicicleta a todas partes...'. (5) Match flow: matches list shows @kai, @sol, @luna from prior swipes; tapping a row opens chat directly.
critical_code_review_comments: Recorded-video flow still stores blob: URLs on the user (App.js VideoPick record mode); blob URLs are per-document and will not load for other users or after refresh. Sample-pick is the tested path and works.
DEV_OTP_STORE is an in-memory dict; OTP state lost on backend restart (acceptable in DEV mock).
send_message has no rate-limit or text-length validation.
haversine_km returns 999.0 when any coord is None (rendered as 'near you' in UI) - logic could be made explicit.

Chat message rendering does not seem to expose data-testid^="chat-message-" on each bubble (queryAll returned 0 even though messages visually render). Adding a per-message data-testid would help future automated assertions; non-blocking.
